jobs_results.title: Ingeniero Backend - Elastic Search
jobs_results.description:
En Blinkfire Analytics estamos buscando un Ingeniero de Software con enfoque en la ingestión procesamiento y agregación de Elasticsearch.

Las responsabilidades clave para este rol abarcan

Desarrollar y mantener arquitecturas de software escalables y eficientes para la creación de productos relacionados con Big Data y contenido de redes sociales.

Colaborar con plataformas en la nube como Google Cloud Platform y Google App Engine para integrar aplicaciones de manera fluida.

Utilizar APIs de redes sociales para desarrollar nuevas características y mantener las existentes. Gestionar clústeres de Elasticsearch involucrando Elasticsearch DSL (Lenguaje Específico de Dominio) Kibana Logstash y Beats.

Asegurar el mantenimiento continuo de clústeres de Elasticsearch incluyendo actualizaciones de versiones de Elasticsearch.

Trabajar colaborativamente con miembros del equipo para asegurar la finalización exitosa de proyectos.

Demostrar apertura para aprender e incorporar tecnologías de... última generación en el entorno laboral.

Formación Académica Se requiere una licenciatura o maestría en ciencias de la computación tecnología de la información o un campo relacionado.

Experiencia Experiencia previa como ingeniero de software o desarrollador con enfoque en trabajar con Elasticsearch u otras tecnologías de búsqueda y análisis similares es una ventaja.

Habilidades Técnicas

Proficiencia en Elasticsearch DSL y tecnologías relacionadas como Kibana Logstash y Beats es una ventaja.

Habilidades de programación en lenguajes comúnmente utilizados con Elasticsearch como Python son deseables.

Experiencia con sistemas de bases de datos modelado de datos y optimización de consultas.

Conocimiento de Plataformas en la Nube Familiaridad con plataformas en la nube como Google Cloud y experiencia en implementar y gestionar clústeres de Elasticsearch en estas plataformas.

Resolución de Problemas Fuertes habilidades analíticas y resolutivas con la capacidad de solucionar problemas y optimizar consultas y clústeres de Elasticsearch.

Colaboración y Comunicación Capacidad para trabajar colaborativamente en un entorno de equipo ya que los ingenieros de Elasticsearch a menudo colaboran con otros desarrolladores en el equipo de ingeniería. Buenas habilidades de comunicación para transmitir eficazmente conceptos técnicos complejos.

Buscamos una persona para incorporarse a nuestra oficina en Valencia en un modelo híbrido de trabajo.

Ofrecemos incorporación inmediata buen ambiente de trabajo en empresa internacional sólida.

Posibilidades de promoción y formación.

Elastic search, Python, Google Cloud, Kivana, Logstash

jobs_results.title: Senior Backend Engineer​/Kotlin
jobs_results.description:
Posición: Senior Backend Engineer (Kotlin/Spring)

Location: Preferably in the Barcelona area and open to hybrid working, but fully remote candidates will be considered.

About Kognia: Kognia Sports Intelligence is on a mission to revolutionize football performance analysis through cutting-edge technology and deep insights into the game. Based in Barcelona and backed by industry giants including Xavi Hernández and Iker Casillas, we are a startup with a passionate team striving to bring actionable insights to coaches, players, and sports enthusiasts.

The Opportunity: We're looking for a strong Backend Engineer to join our team in a period of growth and help us deliver football insights and shape the future of our technology.

Experience level:
Three or more years of experience in backend development or related areas.
Responsibilities
• Contribute to the development of the Kognia platform, in particular our Kotlin/Spring Boot API backend, but also other components as team needs and... skills dictate.
• Improve software quality by identifying issues and opportunities for enhancements, and implementing best practices for reliable, maintainable, testable, and scalable solutions.
• Participate in architecture discussions, domain modeling, and other team decision-making.
• Investigate new technologies and approaches as needed.
• Provide code review and participate in other company activities such as recruitment, professional development, and engineering operations.

Skills and qualifications
Required
• Strong experience in Spring framework (Spring Boot, MVC).
• Strong experience in JVM languages and tooling. Naturally, Kotlin is preferred, but if you’re a Java developer curious about Kotlin, we hope to hear from you too!
• Database experience, and working with abstraction layers in JVM (e.g. JDBC).
• Hands-on experience with best practices in testing and developing with clean code, regardless of stack.
• Ability to adapt to a fast-paced, changing agile environment.
• Excellent team player with strong verbal and written communication skills, in English.
Preferred
• Experience with Spring Boot in Kotlin specifically.
• Knowledge of event-driven architecture -- Kafka and associated ecoystem (e.g. KStreams).
• Interest/familiarity with software design patterns, software architecture, domain-driven design, etc.
• Dev Ops mindset, comfortable with CI/CD, cloud environments, and Kubernetes.
• Other useful stacks for miscellaneous contributions:
JavaScript (Type Script, React) and Python.
#J-18808-Ljbffr

jobs_results.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Grafana Enterprise (Remote, EMEA)
jobs_results.description:
Senior Software Engineer - Grafana Enterprise

What is Grafana?

Grafana software enables you to query, visualize, alert on, and explore your metrics, logs, and traces wherever they are stored. Grafana provides you with tools to turn your data into insightful graphs and visualizations. The Grafana plugin framework also enables you to connect other data sources like databases, ticketing tools, and cloud CI/CD services. Grafana is an open source product with licensed features for enterprise customers. Grafana Labs also operates Grafana Cloud, a SaaS offering that thoughtfully integrates the best-in-breed open source technologies into a curated observability platform, all managed and scaled by the team at Grafana Labs.

Who is the Grafana Enterprise team?

The Grafana Enterprise team delivers features and solutions for medium and large enterprises who operate the Grafana Enterprise product on their own infrastructure. Our customers include software engineers, site reliability engineers... medium, large and global enterprises and leading global cloud service providers. We’re a diverse team of expert technologists working remotely from around the globe. Our meetings tend to happen between 14:00 and 17:00 UTC. We measure ourselves by our openness, helpfulness, and our shared successes.

What will you be doing?
• Earning the trust of our customers to further Grafana’s “big tent” philosophy of data accessibility and to meet clear business objectives
• Leading the development of features for people like you
• Driving continuous improvement of our engineering culture through words and actions.
• Driving projects from initial ideation to production
• Contributing to projects that impact the experience of Grafana operators around the world
• Owning the experience of our customers by participating in weekday 12h x 5d and separate weekend 24h x 2d on-call rotations
• Hiring and developing the best engineers to build the future of Grafana
• Developing your skills as a thought leader to drive continuous improvement of engineering and operational practices across Grafana Labs

As we are remote-first and our engineering organization, we provide guidance and meet regularly using video calls, so strong teamwork and excellent written and interpersonal communication skills are a must.

What are we looking for in you?
• You work well as a communicative member of a team of engineering professionals.
• You earn trust by saying what you mean and doing what you say.
• You are customer focused. You start with the customers’ needs and work backwards.
• You insist on the highest standards and work to develop the skills and knowledge of your fellow team members.
• You take on complex challenges and break them down into digestible problems and leverage your team and organization to deliver.
• You design modular solutions, deliver minimum loveable products, gather data and feedback and then progress iteratively.

Requirements
• Professional experience delivering and operating distributed systems in production in at least one language: preferably Go, but knowledge ofJava, TypeScript, Python, C, C++ or Rust is also advantageous.
• Experience delivering multiple complex software projects end-to-end: from gathering requirements, brainstorming ideas all the way to shipping a product to the customer and operating it on their behalf in production.
• Professional experience with major cloud providers such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
• Experience writing clean, robust, and performant software that is easily maintained by others.

Nice To Haves
• Experience working with Kubernetes.
• Some experience using Grafana software or cloud services, regardless of scale. We particularly want to hear about hobby or passion projects where you’ve used Grafana.
• Familiarity with being on-call and managing production operations for business and/or mission critical distributed information systems.

In Spain, the base compensation range for this role is €78,224 - €93,869. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process. Benefits include equity, bonus (if applicable) and other benefits listed here.
• Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process

About Grafana Labs: There are more than 20M users of Grafana, the open source visualization tool, around the globe, monitoring everything from beehives to climate change in the Alps. The instantly recognizable dashboards have been spotted everywhere from a NASA launch and Minecraft HQ to Wimbledon and the Tour de France. Grafana Labs also helps more than 3,000 companies -- including Bloomberg, JPMorgan Chase, and eBay -- manage their observability strategies with the Grafana LGTM Stack, which can be run fully managed with Grafana Cloud or self-managed with the Grafana Enterprise Stack, both featuring scalable metrics (Grafana Mimir), logs (Grafana Loki), and traces (Grafana Tempo).

Benefits: For more information about the perks and benefits of working at Grafana, please check out our careers page.

Equal Opportunity Employer: At Grafana Labs we’re building a company where a diverse mix of talented people want to come, stay, and do their best work. We know that our company runs on the hard work and the dedication of our passionate and creative employees. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways.

We will recruit, train, compensate and promote regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, disability, age, veteran status, and all the other fascinating characteristics that make us different and unique. We believe that equality and diversity builds a strong organization and we’re working hard to make sure that’s the foundation of our organization as we grow.

For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy

jobs_results.title: Back End Engineer (plus Data/BI)
jobs_results.description:
Estamos ampliando nuestros equipos de desarrollo, no nos importan mucho el título, pero a este rol le llamamos Back End Engineer y la clave es la experiencia en desarrollo de software en entornos .NET, conocimientos en Data y Cloud y constantes ganas de seguir aprendiendo.

Nuestra visión es construir equipos multidisciplinares, los cuales autogestionan directamente de forma AGILE los proyectos, para encontrar y realizar las mejores soluciones😊

¿Qué harás?
• Desarrollarás proyectos desde cero bajo supervisión mínima y con la colaboración del equipo
• Participarás en el diseño de arquitecturas y toma de decisiones en un entorno constructivo y con dinámica de cocreación
• Trabajarás bajo conceptos SOLID
• Serás pieza clave en el desarrollo de buenas prácticas, código limpio y reusable
• Estar al día de las últimas herramientas y tecnologías del mercado

Requirements

¿Qué buscamos?
• Experiencia de al menos 3 años trabajando en entorno .NET con C#
• Experiencia/interés en la... ingeniería de datos, pudiendo trabajar ETL's y visualización en PowerBI
• Experiencia con consultas DAX, análisis services..
• Experiencia/conocimientos en diseño de arquitecturas
• Conocimiento y aplicación de patrones de diseño
• Conocimiento en aplicación de CI/CD como parte indispensable del desarrollo de software
• Buen nivel de inglés (entorno internacional) es valorable, no imprescindible.
• Buena interacción y capacidad de trabajo con los diferentes equipos de las oficinas a nivel global
• Pasión por la tecnología y desarrollo de software
• Constantes ganas de aprender y habilidad para aprender rápidamente
• Team player

Benefits

¿Qué ofrecemos?
• Salario acorde al mercado y tu experiencia 🤑
• Horario flexible 35 horas / semana 😎 (sin reducción de salario)
• Trabajo remoto 100% (opcional) 🌍
• Retribución flexible (restaurante, transporte y guardería) ✌
• Seguro médico y dental (totalmente gratuito para el empleado) 🚑
• Presupuesto individual para formación ycertificaciones de Microsoft gratuitas 📚
• Clases de inglés (1 hora a la semana) 🗽
• Día libre por tu cumpleaños 🌴🥳
• Bonus mensual en concepto de electricidad e internet en casa 💻
• Descuento en plan de gimnasio y actividades deportivas 🔝
• Plain Camp (evento anual de team building) 🎪

➕ El gusto de trabajar siempre con las últimas herramientas tecnológicas.

Con toda esta info ya conoces mucho de nosotros, ¿nos dejas que conozcamos más de ti?

¿El proceso de selección? - Sencillo, 3 pasos: una llamada y 2 entrevistas con el equipo 🤘

Y te preguntarás... ¿Quién es Plain Concepts?

Plain Concepts somos más de 400 personas apasionadas por la tecnología, movidas por el cambio hacia la búsqueda de las mejores soluciones para nuestros clientes y proyectos.

A lo largo de estos años, la empresa ha crecido gracias al gran potencial técnico que tenemos dentro y apoyándonos siempre en nuestras ideas más locas e innovadoras. Contamos con más de 14 oficinas en 6 países diferentes. Nuestro objetivo principal es seguir creciendo como equipo, realizando los mejores y más avanzados proyectos en el mercado.

Realmente creemos en la importancia de reunir personas de diferentes ámbitos y países para formar el mejor equipo, con una cultura plural e inclusiva.

¿Qué hacemos en Plain?

Nos caracterizamos por tener un ADN 100% técnico. Desarrollamos proyectos a medida desde 0, consultorías técnicas y formación.
• No hacemos bodyshopping ni outsorcing
• Nuestros equipos son multidisciplinares y la estructura de organización es plana y horizontal
• Muy comprometidos con los valores AGILE
• Vivir es compartir, nos ayudamos, apoyamos y animamos mutuamente para ampliar nuestros conocimientos internamente y también de cara a la comunidad (con conferencias, eventos, charlas...)
• Siempre buscamos la creatividad e innovación, incluso cuando la idea es una locura para otros
• La transparencia, clave para cualquier relación.

Hacemos realidad las ideas y soluciones de nuestros clientes con un alto grado de excelencia técnica, para más información visita nuestra web:

➡ https://www.plainconcepts.com/es/casos-estudio/

En Plain Concepts, sin duda, buscamos ofrecer igualdad de oportunidades. Queremos solicitantes con diversidad sin importar la raza, color, género, religión, nacionalidad, ciudadanía, discapacidad, edad, orientación sexual o cualquier otra característica protegida por la ley

jobs_results.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs_results.description:
As part of the Affle group, we are looking for a Backend Engineer for our Mediasmart team: an established professional seasoned in development best practices, willing to learn our technology stack and about our business, as a full time addition to our team, whose main function will be to develop for the backend building the next generation of our AdTech software.

This is a 100% backend position. No web frontend experience is needed. The role will report to the Head of Backend and will be a part of a highly motivated and innovative team using state of the art technologies.

About mediasmart

mediasmart is part of the Affle group - a global adtech company that completed its successful IPO in India in 2019 and has been growing profitably since. Affle group has been in the adtech/martech business for over 15 years and runs multiple ad platform businesses including Appnext, MAAS, mDMP, Jampp, RevX, Vizury, Youappi in addition to mediasmart.

Some of the key investors in Affle Holdings... include Microsoft and D2C (JV between NTT DoCoMo & Dentsu).

At mediasmart, our mission is to allow advertisers to effectively reach audiences across their digital journeys in real time, while maximizing engagement with campaigns and their incremental value to advertisers. mediasmart was one of the first players to enter the programmatic mobile ecosystem and to date our proprietary technology stack includes a DSP, DMP & Ad-Server, as well as direct connections to more than 30 ad exchanges where we buy display, video and native ads on mobile apps, Connected TVs, DOOH and desktop.

The mediasmart business is headquartered in Spain having fast growing global teams across APAC, LATAM in addition to Europe.

Our culture and values
• Be a generous team player. One that helps others succeed and celebrate their success.
• Love curiosity. Keep learning and stay relevant.
• It’s a team effort. Collaborate and cooperate to build a smart company.
• Go farther. Be an example for others. Set the bar.
• Love what we do. Love our work with passion and respect.
• Do good and do well. Our work matters.

We work hard and never forget to have fun in the process. Absolutely devoted to our customers and to building the best mobile advertising company out there, our passion shines through everything we do.

If you are looking for new challenges, growth opportunities and a great learning experience (such as AWS certificates or related online/offline courses of your interest) with a young team that strives for innovation and quality of service, this is the company for you.

Summary & Duties

The Backend Engineer will work within a driven and highly motivated team to maintain our product and develop new functionalities. His/her software will be used in mission critical code powering millions of actions per second.

Below are some of the core responsibilities and requirements we envision for the role, which will be done fully remote (our office is in Madrid, you will be always welcomed to work onsite if preferred):
• Deliver new code fast and reliably, and always ensure that it works in production.
• Be able to promptly solve issues directly in the existing code.
• Proactively analyze areas to improve and propose projects to make our product more effective.
• Interact with other teams to build new features or solve technical issues.
• Participate in software architecture decisions guiding the future of mediasmart.
• Coach and train the rest of the team in technology, processes and best practices.
• Participate in code reviews and help your team deliver high quality software.

Requirements
• At least 4-5 years of experience in a similar position or using similar technology.
• Expert knowledge of server side javascript in Node.JS.
• Experience with Go.
• Linux administration.
• CD/CI pipelines and tools, in particular Jenkins.
• Monitoring and Observability (Prometheus, Grafana).
• We value AWS certification in cloud technology.
• Experience with Node.js on distributed highly scalable systems.
• Experience with Rust.
• Experience with NoSQL such as Redis and big data databases: BigQuery, RocksDB...
• Interest in machine learning and statistics. Design and create new algorithms, work with exotic data structures. Follow up the latest developments in scientific papers in the adtech and ML areas.
• Performance Analysis and Tuning.

Skills
• Great communicator, both written and oral, with excellent interpersonal skills.
• Teamwork, collaboration skills.
• Proactivity, critical thinking and good disposition for working in teams.
• Fluency in English both written and spoken.
• Analytical, curious and goal-oriented. A campaign detective eager to find solutions.
• Able to collect and organize data, understand the results and communicate them effectively in words and graphics.
• Problem solver, with a sense of urgency in responding promptly to client and internal requests.

Don’t worry if you lack some of the requirements; we prefer to hear from you rather than passing on the right person.

Other perks of the job
• Remote work: our team is living all over Spain but you are welcome to use our office in the center of Madrid.
• Flexible working hours.
• To be part of a small team with direct impact in the final product
• Using state of the art technologies
• Educational resources
• Creative Fridays: One day every two weeks to work on your own ideas

If you are selected you will have to be ready to show us your most relevant projects, and enter a selection process that will include reading and writing code

jobs_results.title: Back-end Developer
jobs_results.description:
Location: Sanz

Jij bent de programmeur die warm wordt van een mooi nieuw framework. Jij bent de programmeur die zegt: “als het een API heeft, kan ik er mee koppelen”. Jij bent de programmeur die begrijpt wanneer we iets custom moeten bouwen of juist een standaard oplossing moeten gebruiken. Jij bent de programmeur die we zoeken.
Even voorstellen

Van Ons heeft een hele vette vacature uitstaan voor een back-end developer die een aantal van onze grootste projecten naar het volgende niveau kan tillen. Leer ons hieronder kennen en check de details!

Samen met andere getalenteerde, gedreven en gezellige collega’s werk je op onze productievloer vanuit hartje Amsterdam. Met een focus op back-end ben je een belangrijke speler in de projecten die we opleveren voor onze klanten. Als we het goed doen vallen we er ook mee in de prijzen,zoals een notering met New York Media Group in de Deloitte Tech Fast 50 .

Of we winnen de Website van het Jaar 2020, 2021 & 2022 verkiezing met het platform... Indebuurt. We werken voor marketing- en reclamebureau’s of rechtstreeks voor de opdrachtgever in Nederland en daarbuiten en altijd op zoek naar de beste technische oplossing voor het probleem van de klant.

Complexe websites en platformen bouwen samen met zeer ervaren senior collega’s
Jouw rol en competenties
• We zoeken iemand met PHP kennis op medior/senior niveau.
• We werken veel met Laravel:
Nova, Statamic en Filament gebruiken we vaak, dus het is mooi als je daar al iets van weet.
• Je voelt je op je gemak bij het opzetten van high-load en high-performance omgevingen en je weet hoe je back-end omgevingen efficiënt en veilig opzet.
• Object georiënteerd programmeren kent geen geheimen voor jou en je wordt wat nerveus als er niet gewerkt wordt volgens strikte code standaarden.
• Je hebt ervaring met RESTful APIs.

De dag begint met een kopje koffie met collega’s. Even een praatje maken en horen wat er speelt vandaag.

Omdat het geen vrijdag is, kan je mooi dat ene project live zetten op de staging omgeving. Hierdoor heb je de tijd om eventuele foutjes of errors op een stressvrije manier te ondervangen. Na de livegang werk je verder aan een langlopend project. Je pakt een ticket op dat aan jou is toegewezen in Jira. Je start Php Storm op en werkt aan verschillende features.

Tijd voor de lunch. Je doet mee met onze gezamenlijke lunch of haalt iets lekkers om de hoek bij de Albert Cuypmarkt. Het voordeel van werken in hartje Amsterdam. Na de lunch win je nog even een potje Mario Kart van je collega’s en ben je weer opgeladen voor de rest van de dag.

Een oplossing voor een probleem waar je eerder die dag tegenaan liep schiet je te binnen. Je gaat ermee aan de slag, lost het op een gaat weer verder.

Met behulp van Docker start je je ontwikkelomgeving op en werkt verder aan het project waar je in de ochtend mee bezig was. Vanzelfsprekend is je code perfect en is er niks op aan te merken. Je rondt je laatste ticket van de dag af en pusht de changes naar Git Hub.
Uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden

In ruil voor de mooie dingen die je aflevert bieden we je een plek bij misschien wel het leukste en gezelligste internetbureau van Amsterdam (100% reiskosten vergoeding!). Je gaat sowieso mee op ons teamuitje komend voorjaar naar Barcelona (2017), Belgrado (2018), Berlijn (2019) , Porto (2022), Athene (2023), Turijn (2024) doe je mee met lasergamen, poolen, bowlen, sushi eten, Italiaans eten, vrijdagmiddagsnacks eten, tafelvoetballen, bootje varen, met de super stretched Hummer naar een vakantiepark in Zeeland, Sherlocked 1, Sherlocked 2 en alle andere hutje-op-de-hei-sessies.

En verder:
• Salarisindicatie: €3000-€5500 bruto bij 40 uur per week, afhankelijk van leeftijd en ervaring.
• Doorgroeien naar lead developer is mogelijk.
• Op lange termijn kun je toetreden tot de STAK en deel je mee in de winst van het bureau.
• Je komt terecht in een zeer ervaren team.
• Pensioenregeling.
• Persoonlijk opleidings- en ontwikkelingsbudget van minimaal €1000 per jaar.
• Toegang tot events, congressen en seminars.
• Nieuwste Macbook Pro van de zaak.
• 25 vakantiedagen per jaar (bij full time).

Hebben we je interesse en wil je instappen in onze trein? Mail je CV en motivatie naar Robert op (Usted puede enviar una solicitud o contactar con nosotros por email usando el Buzón de Solicitud online de abajo)

Voor de recruiter: je hoeft ons niet te mailen of te bellen naar aanleiding van deze vacature. Thanks

Ja, dat kan natuurlijk ook. Vul hieronder je gegevens in want we komen graag met je in contact!
Sollicitatie contact formulier

Formulier die we gebruiken op /vacatures

Naam *

Voeg eventueel je CV toe Max. bestandsgrootte: 64 MB.
Geen zin in formuliertjes?

Je kunt ons ook een mailtje sturen op . Noteer daar zoveel mogelijk informatie zodat wij een goede inschatting kunnen maken.
#J-18808-Ljbffr

jobs_results.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Experimentation Platform
jobs_results.description:
If you’re here, it’s because you’re looking for an exciting ride.

A ride that will fuel up your ambitions to take on a new challenge and stretch yourself beyond your comfort zone.

We’ll deliver a non-vanilla culture built on talent, where we work to amplify the impact on millions of people, paving the way forward together.

Not your usual app. We are the fastest-growing multi-category app connecting millions of users with businesses, and couriers, offering on-demand services from more than 170,000 local restaurants, grocers and supermarkets, and high street retail stores. We operate in more than 1500 cities across 25 countries. Every year, +200k merchants generate over 4B€ in sales through our platform and over 20M customers get their goods delivered in minutes.

Together we revolutionize the way people connect with their everyday needs, from delivering essentials to connecting our ecosystem of users through innovative solutions powered by technology. For us, every day is filled... with purpose.

What makes our ride unique?

🤝 Our strong culture and non-vanilla personality.

💪 A Talent House.

🤝 Our commitment to being a force for good.

We have a vision: To give everyone easy access to anything in their cities. And this is where your ride starts…

YOUR MISSION

We are looking for talented and passionate engineers to join the Experimentation Platform team within our Data Platform Cluster.

In our cross-functional team, you will be focused on building our internal next-generation platform to pave the way for a diverse set of experimentation capabilities within Glovo. This team provides a crucial platform service for all internal teams and therefore your experience in building stable and scalable solutions is a key element. Besides technical excellence, we are also leading the culture of experimentation providing hands-on support and analytical capabilities to all Glovo engineering teams.

THE JOURNEY
• Become an expert in the end-to-end journey of experimentation. From setting up hypotheses, variant assignments, SDK implementations, user interfaces, data capture to analytical pipelines.
• Actively contribute to our product development roadmap and lead high-impact projects.
• Design and implement innovative solutions for one of Glovo's busiest and most data-intensive services, where your expertise will shape the future of high-traffic platforms.
• Keep our tier-1 system up and running ensuring that our business runs smoothly.
• Mentor engineers across tech teams and share knowledge to make them grow.
• Develop software using modern engineering approaches and agile principles.
• Make our technology and our team scale as the business grows.
• Own your deliverables from start to finish. Deliver high-quality cross-functional solutions within the scope of the team.
• Participate in technical decisions and provide advisory to other teams.

What You Will Bring To The Ride
• A degree in Computer Science or relevant experience.
• 5+ years of relevant full-time experience in software engineering.
• Strong Java or other high-level language skills.
• Experience diagnosing and resolving performance problems in complex software systems.
• Strong will to adhere to best practices in OO development and a need to leave well-structured code in your tracks.
• Experience mentoring team members and leading technical projects.
• Extensive knowledge of object-oriented programming and software architecture.
• The urge to write automated tests.
• Knowledge of relational databases and other approaches to data management.
• Knowledge of concurrency and scalability patterns.
• You have strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

What Can Make You Stand Out
• Strong interest and experience in data-intensive application development
• Experience in fast-growing tech companies and scaleups
• Experience in A/B testing and other experimentation methodologies
• Strong knowledge of statistical analysis / machine learning algorithms
• Proficiency in software architectures and performance optimization techniques
• Past work experience in the field of data engineering or streaming analytics

Even if it seems you don't meet our musts don't let it stop you, we are all about finding the best talent out there! Skills can be learned, and embracing diversity is invaluable.

We Believe Driven Talent Deserves
• 🌟 An enticing equity plan *if applicable
• 💪 Top-notch private health insurance to keep you at your peak.
• 🍔 Monthly Glovo credits so you can test new features in our beta app (and to satisfy your cravings!)
• 💳 Discounts on transportation, food, and even kindergarten expenses or office-based nursery.
• 🏊 Discounted gym memberships to keep you energized.
• 🏖️ The freedom to work from home two days a week, and the opportunity to work from anywhere for up to three weeks a year.
• 👪 Enhanced parental leave (*if applicable)
• 🧠 Online therapy and wellbeing benefits

We’ll deliver a non-vanilla culture built on talent, where we work to amplify the impact on millions of people, paving the way forward together.

At Glovo, we truly value diversity for the positive impact it brings to our teams, products, and culture. We're dedicated to providing equal opportunities for talent from all backgrounds.

Feel free to note your pronouns in your application (e.g., she/her/hers, he/him/his, they/them/theirs, etc).

Delve into our culture by taking a peek at our Instagram and check out our Linkedin and website

If you’re here, it’s because you’re looking for an exciting ride.

A ride that will fuel up your ambitions to take on a new challenge and stretch yourself beyond your comfort zone.

We’ll deliver a non-vanilla culture built on talent, where we work to amplify the impact on millions of people, paving the way forward together.

Not your usual app. We are the fastest-growing multi-category app connecting millions of users with businesses, and couriers, offering on-demand services from more than 170,000 local restaurants, grocers and supermarkets, and high street retail stores. We operate in more than 1500 cities across 25 countries. Every year, +200k merchants generate over 4B€ in sales through our platform and over 20M customers get their goods delivered in minutes.

Together we revolutionize the way people connect with their everyday needs, from delivering essentials to connecting our ecosystem of users through innovative solutions powered by technology. For us, every day is filled... with purpose.

What makes our ride unique?

🤝 Our strong culture and non-vanilla personality.

💪 A Talent House.

🤝 Our commitment to being a force for good.

We have a vision: To give everyone easy access to anything in their cities. And this is where your ride starts…

YOUR MISSION

We are looking for talented and passionate engineers to join the Experimentation Platform team within our Data Platform Cluster.

In our cross-functional team, you will be focused on building our internal next-generation platform to pave the way for a diverse set of experimentation capabilities within Glovo. This team provides a crucial platform service for all internal teams and therefore your experience in building stable and scalable solutions is a key element. Besides technical excellence, we are also leading the culture of experimentation providing hands-on support and analytical capabilities to all Glovo engineering teams.

THE JOURNEY
• Become an expert in the end-to-end journey of experimentation. From setting up hypotheses, variant assignments, SDK implementations, user interfaces, data capture to analytical pipelines.
• Actively contribute to our product development roadmap and lead high-impact projects.
• Design and implement innovative solutions for one of Glovo's busiest and most data-intensive services, where your expertise will shape the future of high-traffic platforms.
• Keep our tier-1 system up and running ensuring that our business runs smoothly.
• Mentor engineers across tech teams and share knowledge to make them grow.
• Develop software using modern engineering approaches and agile principles.
• Make our technology and our team scale as the business grows.
• Own your deliverables from start to finish. Deliver high-quality cross-functional solutions within the scope of the team.
• Participate in technical decisions and provide advisory to other teams.

What You Will Bring To The Ride
• A degree in Computer Science or relevant experience.
• 5+ years of relevant full-time experience in software engineering.
• Strong Java or other high-level language skills.
• Experience diagnosing and resolving performance problems in complex software systems.
• Strong will to adhere to best practices in OO development and a need to leave well-structured code in your tracks.
• Experience mentoring team members and leading technical projects.
• Extensive knowledge of object-oriented programming and software architecture.
• The urge to write automated tests.
• Knowledge of relational databases and other approaches to data management.
• Knowledge of concurrency and scalability patterns.
• You have strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

What Can Make You Stand Out
• Strong interest and experience in data-intensive application development
• Experience in fast-growing tech companies and scaleups
• Experience in A/B testing and other experimentation methodologies
• Strong knowledge of statistical analysis / machine learning algorithms
• Proficiency in software architectures and performance optimization techniques
• Past work experience in the field of data engineering or streaming analytics

Even if it seems you don't meet our musts don't let it stop you, we are all about finding the best talent out there! Skills can be learned, and embracing diversity is invaluable.

We Believe Driven Talent Deserves
• 🌟 An enticing equity plan *if applicable
• 💪 Top-notch private health insurance to keep you at your peak.
• 🍔 Monthly Glovo credits so you can test new features in our beta app (and to satisfy your cravings!)
• 💳 Discounts on transportation, food, and even kindergarten expenses or office-based nursery.
• 🏊 Discounted gym memberships to keep you energized.
• 🏖️ The freedom to work from home two days a week, and the opportunity to work from anywhere for up to three weeks a year.
• 👪 Enhanced parental leave (*if applicable)
• 🧠 Online therapy and wellbeing benefits

We’ll deliver a non-vanilla culture built on talent, where we work to amplify the impact on millions of people, paving the way forward together.

At Glovo, we truly value diversity for the positive impact it brings to our teams, products, and culture. We're dedicated to providing equal opportunities for talent from all backgrounds.

Feel free to note your pronouns in your application (e.g., she/her/hers, he/him/his, they/them/theirs, etc).

Delve into our culture by taking a peek at our Instagram and check out our Linkedin and website

jobs_results.title: Sr Backend Developer - Ruby, Ruby on Rails
jobs_results.description:
About Zen Educate

Our mission is to change the world of education recruitment. Schools spend over £2bn a year on agency staff, with over £600m per year of that spent on fees that go straight to the recruitment agencies. So far, we've saved UK schools over £10m in supply teaching recruitment costs, and that number grows every day, meaning the funding can be put back into education within the schools. Using our online platform, schools have access to hundreds of profiles of fully vetted teachers and support staff, who they can book at a click of a button. Think Uber for teachers. We are well-funded by high-profile investors and are led by start-up veterans behind two of London's most prominent tech companies.

Building on the success of Zen Educate, in 2020 we launched Zen Locum — an online platform that matches locums (temporary workers) with pharmacies and opticians. With significant early traction we're looking to expand this team to continue driving growth.

We're well-funded by... high-profile investors and are led by start-up veterans behind two of London’s most prominent tech companies.

About The Role

Our mission is to change the world of education recruitment. Schools spend over £2bn a year on agency staff, with over £600m per year of that spent on fees that go straight to the recruitment agencies. So far, we've saved UK schools over £10m in supply teaching recruitment costs, and that number grows every day, meaning the funding can be put back into education within the schools. Using our online platform, schools have access to hundreds of profiles of fully vetted teachers and support staff, who they can book at a click of a button. Think Uber for teachers. We are well-funded by high-profile investors and are led by start-up veterans behind two of London's most prominent tech companies.

What You’ll Do

You’ll be joining Zen in a key position. The product delivery team is a crucial part of how Zen will help both transform the supply and recruitment experience for schools and generate the savings the education system needs. This is a great opportunity for someone looking to apply themselves for a great cause and with great responsibility and autonomy to shape our product and development for years to come. We're looking for talented engineer looking to take their skills to the next level by joining a growing, high-performing product delivery team in an agile environment. You'll be:
• Picking up, owning and deploying new features from scratch, working closely with front-end developers
• Reviewing PRs and helping us improve our ways of working
• Investigating and tackling new challenges and responding to bugs
• Writing high quality, well-tested code

What You’ll Bring
• Experience with Ruby, Ruby on Rails (6yrs+)
• Experience refactoring legacy code and considering trade-offs around technical debt - A top performer that wants to be part of a high-performing, motivated team
• Growth mindset — dedicated to growing your skills as a professional
• Passion for work with a positive social impact

jobs_results.title: Backend Engineer RoR
jobs_results.description:
About Vesto

Vesto is an investment platform that allows anyone to put their money to work in a fun, simple and guided way.

Their mission is to help people invest in their future and manage their assets and wealth.

Backed by UNIQ, the benchmark fintech and blockchain venture studio in Western Europe.

The team

Their vision is **to be the place where people can get everything they need to build their financial freedom, overcome life's challenges and afford a better life in the future**.

They are creating the investment app that allows anyone to access financial products to build a sustainable investment portfolio that allows them to overcome life's challenges and afford a better life in the future.

Working at Vesto is about wanting to influence the future of our generation and build the product that helps them make it possible. They are convinced that there is a simple and accessible way for anyone to monetize their savings and they are here to build this space and have an impact... on changing the way ALL voices in the financial market participate and interact with each other.

That's why they are creating an ecosystem that will allow their users to leverage their savings in an easy and intuitive way, providing a community where influencers, investors, banks and financial advisors interact with each other around any type of financial product such as stocks, ETFs, Mutual Funds, Crypto, Commodities.

And since they launched 1 year ago they have been listed as the top 30 most downloaded app in Spain 5 times!

The project
• As a Back-End Developer at Vesto, you will be responsible for the server-side code and APIs of their mobile application.
• You will be involved in the entire product development cycle, including design, development, implementation and maintenance of new and existing features.
• Your work will impact the stability and quality of their mobile applications.
• You will write reusable and maintainable code.
• Ultimately, you will be the driving force behind all back-end activities.

Your mission

You will be responsible for designing and developing scalable and reliable back-end systems, ensuring that they are secure and meet the highest standards of data privacy.

You will also work with front-end developers to integrate the back-end systems with the user interface, ensuring a seamless user experience.

You will be expected to keep up with the latest trends and technologies in back-end development, and to share your knowledge and expertise with the rest of the team.

In this role, you will work closely with our product engineering team to understand the requirements and translate them into functional, high-quality code.

You will need to write reusable and maintainable code that adheres to industry standards and best practices.

What they expect from you
• You are a startup lover and thrive in this type of companies (1-20 employees only)
• You have experience with the programming language Ruby, specifically with the framework Ruby On Rails.
• You have experience with Postgresql and the relational model in general.
• You're analytical and good at time management.
• You have great problem-solving skills and you work well in a team.
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
• At least 3 years of experience in startups preferably in a fintech or financial organization.
• Strong technical background and hands-on experience with software development, infrastructure management, and cloud technologies.
• Strong communication and collaboration skills
• Fluent in english preferible but not mandatory
• EU based

Benefits & perks
• Competitive salary, flexible work schedules and a supportive and collaborative work environment.
• Opportunities for professional growth and development, including attendance at conferences, workshops and other training programs.
• At Vesto, they highly value innovation, creativity and a passion for making a difference in the world.
• Someone who thrives in this type of environment, working alongside a small team of 1-20 employees.
• You will have the opportunity to work on cutting-edge technology and have a real impact on the financial technology industry.
• If you are passionate about developing high quality software and making a difference in people's lives, we want to hear from you
